get.summary: Finish a sign-in with Google or GitHub
get.description: Takes code and state, or the provider's error when the user declined. Links the provider account by verified email, dropping a password and the sessions it opened, or creates a user without a password. 400 when state does not match the oauth_state cookie, 409 when the user already has another account of the provider, 422 without code and state or error, 503 when the provider is not reachable.

post.summary: Move an Application to another stage
post.description: Writes the stage event and moves the Application in one transaction. fromStage is the stage the card left: another current stage is 409 conflict, a move the stage machine refuses is 409 illegal_transition. A move to rejected needs reasonCode while askRejectionReason is on (unspecified counts). occurredAt defaults to now and may be in the past, never before the previous event.
